items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Matt Carey told me that. He said sometimes they would tie the wagons...

ctx.x: Sometimes people told us they'd tie the two wagons together so the other band couldn't get away. Couldn't get away. Oh, well. You don't remember that. Matt Carey told me that. What? Matt Carey told me that. He said sometimes they would tie the wagons, and everybody was scared of Kepard, he said. So whatever Kepard's band would, anybody that Kepard would play with would come, they would tie it so that the other band could make a getaway, you know?
That was Freddie Kepard. Yeah. That was Olympia. Olympia band. Mm-hmm.
